proposal.reason: Main change is to contribution/review automation: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py redefine module routing, invitation persistence, and approval requirements; new/renamed workflows (review-routing/review-module/review-gate/review-squash-preview/review-command) rewire review-gate and squash-preview lifecycle; commit_message_squash.py plus commit_attribution.py add squash-preview attribution enforcement. These are workflow policy/automation changes, not PCCL runtime modules.
